usage: 德國 is a noun referring to the country Germany.
You can use 德國 as a subject or object in a sentence, e.g., 德國好有名 (Germany is very famous).
When talking about travel, you can say 我去過德國 (I have been to Germany).
德國 can also be used to describe nationality, for example, 德國人 (German person).
It is common to use 德國 with verbs like 去 (go), 識 (know), or 講 (speak) when discussing the country or language.
